main_text.l: בְּלוֹתִי , seu בַּלּוֹתִי perfudi , perfundere me , praet. Kal, 1. sing. vel, Infin. Kal, aff. à Rad. בָּלַל, vel Inf. Piel, aff. R. בָּלָה.
בְּלִי non, particula Adv. à part. R. בַּל.
בְּלִילָה nihilum, vide, in part. Rad. בַּל.
בְּלֵילוֹת in noctibus , No. pl. à sing. No. Rad. לַיִל.
בְּלִיַּעַל nequam, à בַּל, vel בְּלִי non, & שׁוּל? jugum, vel, יָעַל profuit, vide part. Rad. בָּל.
בְּלִיל farrago , No. f. m. Rad. בָּלַל miscuit.
בִּלְמְדִי in discere me, Inf. Kal, praef. aff. R. לָמַד.
בִּלְעֲדֵי praeterquam , vide in Rad. בַּל non, vel בְּלַעֲדֵי absorpsit.
בִּלְתִּי , vide supra, בַּלּוֹתִי .
בִּלְתִּי excepto, vide in Rad. בַּ, ubi &, מִבִּלְתִּי prae-
terea quòd non, בִּלְתִּי absque te, &c.
ב מ
בָּם in iis , &c. comp. ex praef. בְּ in , & aff. ם iis, &c.
בִּמֹאזְנַיִם in stateris, No. du. מֹאזְנַיִם, praef. R. אָזַן auris.
בְּמַאְרָב in insidiis, No. f. m. מַאְרָב, à R. אָרַב insidiatus est.
בְּמְגוּרֵיהֶם in commoratione, ipsorum, No. מְגוּר, praef. & aff. à Rad. גּוּר commoratus fuit.
בִּמְגִלַּת in volumine, No. f. faem. מְגִלָּה, constr. praef. Rad. גָּלַל volvit.
בַּמָּה in quo, comp. ex praef. בְּ, & מָה .
בְּמַהֲמֹרוֹת in foveis, No. pl. faem. מַהֲמֹרוֹת, praef. Rad. הָמַר.
בְּמוֹ in, est comp. ex בְּ, in, & expletiva particula מוֹ.
בְּמוֹעֲדֵיהֶם

page.notes: Printed text: Hebrew and Latin dictionary entries. The page number "47" at the top right is faint; read as 47 with a doubt. The left column ends with "prae-" and the right column begins "terea", a word divided at the column break, so "praeterea" is one word. Several Hebrew vocalisations are doubtful and not checked against the scan, notably the forms in the entry for "jugum" (שׁוּל?) and "מָה". A patch of the page (around the entry "in foveis") is greyed and blurred, but the words are readable. Some Hebrew words at line ends are cut off by the column edge and are copied as far as they can be read.
